title: 99 Hairpin Bends to Heaven's Gate — China's Wildest Mountain Road | China Travel Expert
description:
99 hairpin bends in 11 kilometers — most people are carsick before they reach the top of Tianmen Mountain.

Tongtian Avenue (the "Heaven-Linking" road) above Zhangjiajie climbs from about 200 m to 1,300 m through 99 sharp turns. At the top, 999 steps lead up to Heaven's Gate — a natural arch 131.5 m tall punched clean through the cliff. Don't fancy the road? The Tianmen cableway is 7,455 m long — billed as the world's longest high-mountain passenger cableway — and takes about 28 minutes hanging over the valley.

🧭 Expert Tip: ride the cable car UP for the views, walk the cliff-edge glass skywalks at the top, then take the 99-bend shuttle bus DOWN — you see everything once and skip the worst of the queues.
